name: read-miss-answers-not-found
description: A read of a locator that never existed, on a server that keeps durable records and could have restored one, answers NOT_FOUND on -32002 with a body carrying no detail. -32002 is the number a missing resource already rides on, and for a locator keyed by session id a missing session and a missing resource are one condition. The absent detail is what keeps this answer identical to a refusal.
